RESULT 05/08/26

✅ Implementation: Profile Liked Posts API

Summary

Added a private endpoint for the liked-post profile tab. It returns a minimal paginated grid of posts liked by the authenticated user.

Route

GET /users/me/liked?page=1&limit=9

Registered in src/Routes/V1/LikesRoutes.go:

user.Get("/me/liked", Controllers.ListProfileLikedPosts)

Access

  • Only role user is accepted.
  • Header role must match token role.
  • User ID comes from authenticated UserDatas; no profile username can be supplied.
  • viewer and other roles receive 401 Unauthorized.

Query

The action queries like AS l, then joins posts AS p and post-owner users AS u.

Filters:

  • l.user_id equals authenticated user ID.
  • p.is_publish = true.
  • p.visibility <> 'private'.
  • Post and owner are not banned.
  • Post slug is not in authenticated user's blocked-post Redis list.
  • Owner encrypt is not in combined blocked/deactivated Redis lists.

Results are ordered by l.updated_at DESC and return only p.slug, p.thumbnail.

Model

type ProfileLikedPost struct {
    Slug      string  `json:"slug"`
    Thumbnail *string `json:"thumbnail"`
}

Objective

Add a private profile-tab API that lists posts liked by the authenticated user.

Route

GET /users/me/liked?page=1&limit=9

Requirements

  • Allow only authenticated role user with matching role header/token.
  • Resolve user identity from authentication; do not accept a username parameter.
  • Return only slug and thumbnail per post.
  • Include only published, non-private, non-banned posts from non-banned owners.
  • Exclude posts blocked by the authenticated user.
  • Exclude posts owned by blocked or deactivated users.
  • Order by latest like activity.
  • Default pagination to page=1, limit=9.
  • Return total, page, and limit.
  • Add no database view or dependency.

Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List Profile Liked Posts",
    "posts": [
      {
        "slug": "post-slug",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg"
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 9
  }
}

RESULT 05/08/26

✅ Implementation: Check Username API

Summary

Added authenticated GET /users/username/check/:username for profile username validation and availability.

Behavior

  • Validates 5–30 lowercase letters, numbers, or underscores.
  • Rejects all-numeric usernames.
  • Returns available: true and changed: false for the authenticated user's current username without checking availability.
  • Queries users.username only for changed valid usernames.
  • Returns clear 400, 401, and 500 errors.

Files Changed

  • src/Action/V1/Users/CheckUsername.go
  • src/Action/V1/Users/CheckUsername_test.go
  • src/Controllers/V1/UsersControllers.go
  • src/Routes/V1/UsersRoutes.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/User/Check Username.yml

Verification

go test ./src/Action/V1/Users
go test ./...

Objective

Add an authenticated API for checking username validity and availability during profile editing.

Route

GET /users/username/check/:username

Requirements

  • Allow only authenticated role user with matching role header/token.
  • Accept 5–30 characters.
  • Allow only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
  • Reject usernames containing only numbers.
  • Return 400 with a clear validation message for invalid input.
  • When input equals the current username, return available and unchanged without an availability query.
  • Check exact username availability for changed input.
  • Return unavailable as a normal 200 result.
  • Add no dependency, model, view, or migration.

Verification

go test ./...
